_readme: One entry per image slot. Put the ORIGINAL, untouched photo in src/assets/originals/ using the 'source' filename, then run: npm run images. Nothing is generated for a slot until its source file exists. 'ratio' is width/height of the crop. 'focal' is the point (0 to 1, left/top) the crop is centred on. 'zoom' (optional, default 1) crops tighter than the largest possible crop; it never enlarges, the output is always cut from real pixels.
